# Heyy

Connect with your customers on Whatsapp, SMS, Messenger and Instagram using automation.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/heyy/.

## Actions

- **Create Webhook**: Create a new webhook for receiving event notifications across multiple channels.
- **Delete Attribute**: Delete an attribute by its unique identifier.
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete a webhook by its unique identifier.
- **Create Contact**: Create a new contact in Heyy with optional details including first name, last name, email, phone number, labels, and custom attributes.
- **Create Contact Attribute**: Create a new custom attribute for contacts in Heyy.
- **Create Label**: Create a new label for categorizing contacts in Heyy.
- **Delete Label**: Delete a label by its unique identifier.
- **List API Webhooks** (read-only): Retrieve all API webhooks configured for the account.
- **List Attributes** (read-only): Retrieve all attributes available in the Heyy system.
- **List Automations** (read-only): Retrieve automation workflows for a specified channel.
- **List Channels** (read-only): Retrieve all available channels from the Heyy system.
- **List Message Templates** (read-only): Retrieve all message templates available in the Heyy system.
- **Update Webhook**: Update a webhook's URL and active status.
